# Set71 public wallet reader reference

`public.json` is the frozen independent Python corpus, SHA256
`e5b71e541b8fd41328dc46ccfd4c14fb9f3de724eea34e9d2fec3d54b349ed3c`.
It has 25 binary row cases, 38 bounded inventory cases and 13 conservative size
compositions. Synthetic key spans are inert public bytes, not valid encryption.

Complete locked sources, all 75 public inputs and the portable reproduction
command are retained in the paired chain checkout at
`slug/testdata/hosted-current-recovery/reference`. Both Python 3.14.3 and 3.9.6
reproduce this file exactly. No new Go output supplied expected values.
